text:
maria: Heads up — post-demo with Acme we need to decide which features to trim to keep Feb release. Demo surfaced latency and auth gaps. Can we do a quick slice call (30m)?

devin: Can you drop a must-have vs nice-to-have list? My draft: must = core gen, token billing, auth; nice = reranking, multi-tenant metrics UI, advanced routing.

tariq: Customer note — Acme will push hard on reranking. They said perceived quality jumps with rerank; they'd consider signing if we can pilot it.

ashley: Reranking adds ~30% memory and complicates batching. For MVP we could ship a lighter rerank (top-k=5) behind a feature flag to limit surface area.

jen: If we promise a pilot rerank in the v1 window they may sign. Need a firm timeline to tell them.

devin: Engineering estimate for a limited rerank behind a flag: ~2w eng + 1w infra (canary + autoscale tweaks + tracing). Full rollout is larger.

maria: Tradeoff question: include rerank in MVP behind flag (Dedicated-first) or cut and push to v1? Which reduces launch risk the most?

tariq: From CS POV cutting risks the deal, but Acme might accept a Dedicated-only pilot. That gives them the feature without exposing hosted customers.

ashley: Dedicated-only pilot is safest operationally — isolates the heavier memory+batching behavior. Still needs work (deploy pipelines + canary config).

devin: Proposal: MVP = core gen + auth + billing + limited rerank behind flag for Dedicated; v1 = full rerank across tenants + metrics UI + routing polish. This reduces blast radius.

maria: OK. Proposed launch criteria to lock: 99th pct latency < 600ms for gen, auth integration tests passing, billing E2E, Dedicated canary with rerank successful for 48h. Agree?

jen: :thumbsup: I'll tell Acme we can do a Dedicated pilot for rerank. Timeline we can promise: pilot enablement in ~6 weeks, full customer rollout in 8-10 weeks pending pilot results.

tariq: Add action: need Acme eval set + SLOs for rerank regressions. CS will request eval artifacts this week.

maria: I'll update the milestone tracker and write a quick follow-up doc with owners and checklist.

devin: approve

ashley: approve

-tariq: approve if Acme signs the pilot acceptance doc

jen: approve

release-bot: deploy status: none scheduled

maria: Thanks all — follow-up doc + meeting notes coming in #product.
